name: Jinju AI Integrated Data Center
notes: Aju Press reports Mayor Cho's pledge to attract/build an AI integrated data center through government public offerings as part of Jinju's AI and space-service strategy; no site, capacity, or permit evidence found.

name: Sacheon Sky City AI Data Center
developer: Tae Wang D&D; Hyundai Engineering & Construction builder
notes: Asia Business Daily reports the AI data center passed an 80 MW power-system impact assessment, completed traffic/landscape/architectural committee reviews, and was awaiting final building permits at 1121 Sadari, Chukdong-myeon in the Sacheon IC Integrated Distribution Industrial Complex; Maeil Business later reported implementation design underway.

name: Sacheon Sky City AI Data Center expansion
developer: Tae Wang D&D / project partners not fully disclosed
notes: Maeil Business reports an additional 120 MW data center is planned in the same Sacheon area to form a large-scale AI cluster; details beyond the planned capacity were not found.

name: Korea Space Data Center
developer: Korea AeroSpace Administration (KASA) / public-private space data ecosystem
notes: KASA posted a 2026 meeting item titled 'Korea's Space Data Center to Serve as a Gateway for AI and ICT Companies to Enter the Space Industry.' The page confirms KASA's Sacheon address and government discussion of the space data center, but does not provide a physical facility capacity or construction schedule.

name: Philip Morris Korea Yangsan Data Center structured cabling project
developer: Philip Morris Korea; Linknzone cabling contractor
notes: Contractor project list includes 'PHILIP MORRIS Korea / Yangsan Data Center Structured Cabling System Project' in its 2017 section. Treated as evidence of an existing corporate/enterprise data center or data room; no public capacity or facility details found.

name: Digital Edge Bupyeong / Incheon campus (SEL2 and SEL3)
notes: Digital Edge announced a Bupyeong-gu greenfield project in 2022; DCD's 2026 update says the first self-built Korean facility, 36 MW SEL2, launched in October 2024 and the Bupyeong campus will offer 100 MW at full build-out across two buildings, with 60 MW SEL3 due live next year. Original 2022 announcement described 120 MW, so 100 MW is the latest reported full-build figure found.

name: STACK Infrastructure ICN01A / ESR Incheon data center
notes: STACK and ESR announced a 48 MW Incheon data center in Seoul's western suburbs, with KEPCO power secured, Q1 2023 construction start, Q4 2024 ready-for-service target, and operation under the STACK brand. The source does not name Bupyeong-gu, but data-center directories place ICN01A at 27 Annam-ro 418beon-gil, Bupyeong-gu.

name: ESR / Wide Creek KR1 Data Center (PDG SE1)
developer: ESR Group and Wide Creek Asset Management; leased to Princeton Digital Group
notes: DCD reports ESR is developing the nine-story KR1 facility in Incheon's Bupyeong district, construction starting in November 2025 and operation expected in 2028, to be leased to PDG. ESR's property page describes Bupyeong KR1 as an 80 MW facility on nearly 11,000 sqm of land.

name: LG CNS Incheon Center
notes: LG CNS states it has operated data centers since opening Korea's first data center, the Incheon Center, in 1992. A data-center directory places LG CNS Incheon Center at 23 Anaji-ro 213beon-gil in Bupyeong-gu; no reliable public capacity figure found.
